Your confirmed January 2027 registration is for The Step Up to Senior Leadership, in the Live Classroom format.

Complete my intake and see next steps

We meet on six Saturdays from 9 January to 13 February 2027, 11 AM to 12:30 PM IST, on Google Meet.

You get 12 lessons, personal coaching feedback on every weekly submission, three printable workbooks and one private 60-minute coaching session. Keep every download. Recordings are available for 90 days.

Bring an anonymized update from your own work for the first week. Private joining details are sent after intake and payment verification.

Full refund if requested before the second live session. For January, request it before 11 AM IST on 16 January 2027. Reply with your payment reference if you need help.
